name: Zod
summary: TypeScript-first schema validation library with static type inference: define a schema, parse data, get a typed result.
description: A validation library where you define a schema and parse data with it to get a strongly typed, validated result. It has zero external dependencies, works in Node.js and all modern browsers, ships a 2 kB gzipped core, an immutable API, a concise interface, built-in JSON Schema conversion and a large ecosystem, for TypeScript and plain JS.
contains: works in Node.js and all modern browsers
immutable API: methods return a new instance
works with TypeScript and plain JS
